grade.primary_choice: Separate TypeScript BullMQ worker on Fly with pre-generated PDFs in object storage
unsupported_claims: 'Month end is this Friday (Oct 31)': 31 October 2026 is a Saturday, and the team never gave a date
'A faster language would shrink 20 CPU-minutes to maybe 5–10' is a guessed speed-up with no measurement behind it, though it is hedged and only used to argue against a rewrite
grade.notes: Excellent answer: it names event-loop blocking as the root cause, does the maths, reuses Redis/BullMQ, runs a separate Fly process group, pre-generates into object storage with signed URLs, stays in TypeScript, and lists the right unknowns to measure. The only slips are a wrong weekday for Oct 31 and a speculative speed-up figure for another language.
